preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the cobweb is between 2 and 105, inclusive.
Each node is connected to another node within the range of node numbers.
The clamminess value of each thread is between 1 and 10^9 + 6, inclusive.
The color of each thread is either red (0) or black (1).

postconditions.description: The output is the jelliness of the cobweb modulo 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: output is 1 if there are no paths such that the numbers of red and black threads differ at most twice
postconditions.description: The output is 1 if there are no valid paths.
